stem: A hospital system is (1) migrating a one-time bulk archive of on-premises NFS scans into Amazon S3 before decommissioning an old file server, and (2) will keep serving its remaining on-premises radiology application from a local cache backed by AWS storage indefinitely afterward. (Select TWO.)
rationale: AWS DataSync is billed per GB transferred with no appliance to run, fitting the one-time bulk migration of NFS scans into S3 before the old file server is decommissioned. AWS Storage Gateway keeps serving on-premises applications from a local cache backed by AWS storage indefinitely, which matches the second, ongoing requirement rather than a migration that finishes and disconnects. AWS Transfer Family provides managed SFTP/FTPS/AS2 endpoints for exchanging files with external partners; neither described need is an external partner file exchange. Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP is a managed file system for workloads that specifically need NetApp's engine; it is not a migration tool or a hybrid on-premises caching gateway. AWS Backup centralizes policy-driven backup across AWS resource types; it neither performs a one-time bulk migration nor keeps an on-premises application running against a local cache.
